name: Kujou Sakura
source:
She is the president of the student council and is admired throughout the school. She is cool and never breaks her facial expression at any time, but she can say the most outrageous things with a straight face.

While she has an aura that makes it difficult for anyone to get close to her, for some reason she loves the main character very much and tries to go to and from school with him. 

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
